hooks.name: inventory_move_item
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's InventoryMoveItemEvent)

rust_summary: A hopper moves an item between containers (`native_inventory_move_item`).
doc_summary: A hopper is about to move one item between containers: `native_inventory_move_item(source, destination, item, cancel)` runs before the source slot is changed, a composter's bone meal included; a chest boat or minecart is reported at the block it is in. Set `cancel` to keep the item in its source slot. Bundles need "hooks": @API:inventory_move_item@.
